usage: AddBackMissingVariantsInGenotyping.py [-h] [--vcf_fn VCF_FN]
                                             [--clair3_input_vcf_fn CLAIR3_INPUT_VCF_FN]
                                             [--output_fn OUTPUT_FN]
                                             [--switch_genotype SWITCH_GENOTYPE]

Genotype VCF in postprocessing

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --vcf_fn VCF_FN       Candidate sites VCF file input for genotyping
  --clair3_input_vcf_fn CLAIR3_INPUT_VCF_FN
                        Clair3 input vcf
  --output_fn OUTPUT_FN
                        Output vcf file name
  --switch_genotype SWITCH_GENOTYPE
                        Switch missed variant genotype to ./.
